messages.subject: Re: Deploying error, no error code, no obvious "show logs" problem, any ideas?
parts:
I think that the warning with the OS X path is a red herring, but it's interesting and likely due to you deploying some part of your local environment (.RData perhaps?)

The stack trace appears to be having an issue actually starting your Shiny application. How are you creating your application? A ui.R and server.R, or app.R?

messages.author: 4e0769cf76240960
messages.subject: Re: Deploying error, no error code, no obvious "show logs" problem, any ideas?
parts:
I tried deploying the app using ui.R and server.R. But I got the error - could no find ui. I then pasted the two scripts together again and created a new project directory, where i deleted the if interactive { }, parenthesis around the script and deployed the app to a new shinyapp.oi profile. This worked! and the image uploaded too. 

This has taken me several days to solve. 

Thanks anyway.
